actual_scope: Prove the descriptor-only embedded-child interpretation and join actual full-ring preparation, generated control and completed children on complete generic packets, including fresh stock and global field ages after unit reset.

A generic complementary-projector caller permits complete finite execution of this interface without mislabeling a small test as the selected GL64 payload.

stop_rule: Prove the full-volume interpretation and pass complete stated generic packets with actual children, or isolate the failed caller implication. Keep selected family/owner/hosting realization and full bit-cost compilation outside the finite-execution claim.
evidence: PROOF.md gives the interpretation and generic caller induction. RESULT.json records 1,456,542 records checked at two endpoints, 872 completed children, complete high cubes, a real internal unit-reset child, fresh stock, payload parking and six rejection controls.
